description: Update site settings: title, keyConvention, editingMode, signature ("Made with dotsy" badge; live immediately), trailingSlash, ownSeoFiles, aiTrain, acceptIssues and the language settings. Slug is the hostname — use rename_site. Set editingMode 'staged' before handing the editor to a person via start_edit_session's draftEditorUrl.

acceptIssues.description: true keeps the remaining SEO and page-health warnings as they are (get_site_tasks hides them until a check finds more); false undoes. Needs verify_page first. Ask the person first.

aiTrain.description: Whether AI training crawlers may use the live site. true (the default) allows them. false asks them not to. Live immediately.

defaultLanguage.description: The site's main language, a code like "en" (invalid → 400 invalid_language). null removes every language setting. Takes effect at the next publish.

editingMode.description: How the editor's Save behaves. 'live' (default) publishes each save; 'staged' keeps drafts until publish_site. Prefer 'staged' when handing the editor to a person (start_edit_session → draftEditorUrl). API writes always stage.

hreflang.description: "auto" (default) tells search engines which pages are translations of each other; "off" stops that. Applies at publish.

languages.description: The OTHER languages (not the main one); replaces the list. Needs a main language. Applies at publish.

image.description: Asset key of a flag or icon the switcher can show.

label.description: Name shown in the switcher (default: the language's own name).

prefix.description: Folder for this language, like "/es" (default "/" + code). null = no folder.

publish.description: false hides this language from translation links, search alternates and the switcher; pages still serve. Default true.

ownSeoFiles.description: Use the site's own robots.txt even if it blocks the whole site (Disallow: /), and its static sitemap.xml, which replaces the generated one. A robots.txt without Disallow: / is always used. Applies at the next publish.

signature.description: "Made with dotsy" badge. Changes go live at once, no publish needed.

enabled.description: Show the badge in a bottom corner of every published page.

mark.description: Resting look: 'dot' (senna dot, default) or 'logo' (dotsy logo).

reveal.description: 'seal' (stamp on hover, default), 'pill' (label on hover) or 'eye' (seal always open, its dot follows the pointer).

side.description: Preferred bottom corner: 'right' (default) or 'left'. If something covers it, the badge moves to the other corner, the centre or above it.

trailingSlash.description: Page URL form. 'ignore' (default): /blog and /blog/ both serve the page. 'never': /blog/ 301s to /blog. 'always': /blog 301s to /blog/. The canonical tag and sitemap use the same form. Live immediately, no publish needed.

name: update_site
